what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Pakistan in Greece: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 988 Pakistani asylum seekers in Greece, 1.5% of all asylum seekers from Pakistan.
Refugees from Pakistan, a separate group, live mostly in Afghanistan, the United Kingdom, Italy and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Pakistan in 1995 and 1996 and in every year from 2007 to 2025, with the TTP among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict over Balochistan territory in periods from 2004 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 48 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 16055, at the end of 2013; the main years of displacement in the data are 2010, 2013 and 2018.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Greece.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Greece only.
